Subject: Synthesis: Candidate Iqbal — final score pull + annotation requests

Hi all —

Quick ask: we need final scorecards and any short behavioral notes for Asad Iqbal (SWE II) by end of day Thursday so we can decide whether to extend an on-site. Right now Greenhouse shows three completed reviews and two missing (Jonas, Vanessa).

What I need from you:
- Final numeric score (0-10 by rubric) + one-line recommendation (advance / hold / no)
- One short sentence calling out any major risk (ex: design depth, system scale, ownership)
- Attach your scorecard PDF or paste comments inline if easier

I’ve attached the consolidated template and pasted the current snapshot in the linked doc. Please reply-all with your score so I can fold it into the consolidated CSV. If anyone wants to discuss tradeoffs, I can host a 20m sync Friday 10:30 PT — otherwise I’ll make a call with the data.

Attachments: consolidated-score-template.xlsx (in Drive)
Link: https://greenhouse.example.com/candidates/12345

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim

Thanks Rachel — uploaded my annotated card (mina-scorecard-iqbal-annotated.pdf) and pasted highlights below.

Score: 6.5/10 — Hold. Notes:
- Strengths: clear debugging strategy, writes concise tests, good API reasoning.
- Concerns: examples of long-term ownership are lightweight; struggled with tradeoffs on caching vs consistency in the systems question.
- Behavioral flag: when pressed on a mis-release example candidate minimized cross-team impact; recommend probing ownership and escalation behavior at on-site.

Recommendation: Hold for on-site only if we can schedule a targeted ownership/incident-handling slot; otherwise do not advance.

Thanks for the quick turnarounds. I’ve consolidated the inputs into the attached CSV (consolidated-scores-iqbal.csv) and pulled a quick delta view. Current numeric snapshot (simple mean): Marissa 8.0, Jonas 7.0, Mina 6.5, Vanessa (missing). Provisional mean 7.17.

Summary callouts:
- Strengths: debugging, clear API rationale (consistent across reviewers).
- Primary risk: ownership/incident posture (flagged by Mina + Jonas).
- Operational ask: Vanessa, can you drop your score and 1-line rec by EOD Monday? If we don’t have Vanessa, we have two options: 1) run a 15m tie-break with Jonas+Marissa (I can moderate) or 2) move forward with conditional on-site that includes an ownership-focused interview.

If we go with option 2, recruiting will prep an incident/ownership exercise and share with interviewers. If option 1, please RSVP for a 15m slot Tue 10:00 PT or Tue 16:00 PT.

Links: final consolidated sheet + reviewer notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcdEFgHIjklMnOpQ-review-notes
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.example.com/candidates/12345
